CustomField.description: The one number shown as the lead line of this project's case study card on the home page, for example 8 steps. The case study cards read the Case Metric fields and the "How this site is built" section reads the Headline Metric fields. Shown only when Case Metric Label is also set. Only numbers the owner can back up.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Short number with its unit, 24 characters at most. Leave blank to show no number on the case study card. It never falls back to the Headline Metric.
CustomField.label: Case Study Metric
